# `silk/platform/linux/start`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The program entry for a static, non-PIE Linux executable with no libc.

## When to use
Select this module as the runtime root of the artifact, with `libc` set to `none` and the loader
entry `_start`. The application supplies `pub fn main(inputs: &ProcessInputs) -> i32`. Use
`silk.platform.native.start` for a normal hosted program.

## Details
At start, the entry decodes the kernel stack with `ProcessInputs.decode` and calls `main` one
time. The return value of `main` becomes the status of `exit_group`. If the process inputs are
not valid, the process exits with status `127`.

## Gotchas
- There is no suspension storage and no report provider. `main` must be a synchronous function,
  not an effect.
- A fatal trap does not run cleanup and does not print a report.
